scope: Frontend display, reply and forward citations, and deterministic thread ordering for core-validated RFC 3339 received_at values. This report does not mutate stored timestamps or establish native WebKit evidence.

Mounted MailList with the same value threw RangeError: Invalid time value.

behavior: Accept only strict RFC 3339 shape, calendar fields, offset fields, a UTC field round trip, and a :60 that maps to the final second of an end-of-month UTC day before displaying a timestamp.
Map a valid :60 leap second to the final JavaScript-representable millisecond of that minute for display only.
Keep received_at unchanged in message, reply, forward, and thread data.
Display malformed or missing timestamps as Unknown date without crashing Reader or MailList.
Order ordinary 23:59:59.999 before 23:59:60 before fractional :60 values before the following minute, even though every leap-second display representation is 23:59:59.999.
Keep malformed timestamp rows in the pre-existing lower bucket and resolve their order through the existing Message-ID then local-ID tie policy.
